Tharoor, Channi Lead Parliamentary Committees

Shashi Tharoor has been reappointed as the head of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on External Affairs. Charanjit Singh Channi has also been reappointed as the chairman of the Parliamentary panel on agriculture. Both appointments are for their respective committees.
